boxActivation.wheelDesc: A single block to paste into the wheel's Raspberry Pi terminal: token, identity, fallback line to the box and Spark-Local Wi-Fi, then the agent restarts.

userDetail.setupHelpStep1Desc: In the « Wheel identity » card below, choose a serial number (e.g. 152) and click « Generate ». The box name (e.g. spark-box-000152) comes from it: without an identity, nothing else is possible.
userDetail.setupHelpStep2Title: 2. Configure the wheel (one command to paste)
userDetail.setupHelpStep2Line1: In the « Box activation » card, click « Copy the wheel command block ». Then, in a Mac terminal, send it to the wheel without showing it:
userDetail.setupHelpStep2Line2: It writes the token, the identity, the fallback line to the box and the Spark-Local Wi-Fi by itself, then restarts the agent, and nothing secret is shown on screen. Nothing else to type or edit. (On Windows: paste the block into the wheel's SSH session.)
userDetail.setupHelpStep3Line1: Put the master image on the box, plug it in with a network cable, then click « Prepare a box » in the « Box activation » card. A one-time code appears: write it down (valid 24 h).
userDetail.setupHelpStep3Line2: Click « Open the box assistant » (from a computer or phone on the same network as the box), type the code and choose a password for the box. The box configures itself (name, token, Spark-Local Wi-Fi): no command line.
userDetail.setupHelpStep4Desc: The « Wheel ready » badge in the sidebar must be green, and so must the « Offline box » badge right above it. The diagnostics window (click « Wheel ready ») shows the wheel identity and the box state: they must match what was just configured.
userDetail.endRentalConfirm: End the rental? The wheel goes back to the depot and its box will be erased the next time it reaches the internet. The client keeps their account, campaigns and CRM.

profit.disclaimer: Contribution = recognized revenue of the wheel − API costs during its rentals − other direct costs. It is a partial margin, not a net margin; coverage (contribution ÷ lot cost) is a steering indicator, not an accounting depreciation. Fixed costs (hosting…) are never spread over wheels.

formula.recognized: Sum of the recognized revenue entries dated in the period (cancellations included). Source: revenue ledger. Real.
formula.forecast: Current forecast entries: next period of each running rent, running rentals, planned rentals. Never added to recognized revenue. Computed.
formula.mrr: Sum of the monthly rents in force on the date: one rent per wheel held by a reseller + running long-term contracts. Computed.
formula.contribution: Recognized revenue − API costs imputed in the period. A partial margin, never a net margin (fixed costs and wheel direct costs excluded). Incomplete while API calls have no tariff.
formula.rentals: Wheel attributions to a client (direct or sub-client) starting in the period. Source: attributions. Real.
formula.active: Active: attributions running right now. Upcoming: planned rentals. Real.
formula.utilization: Rented days ÷ available wheel-days (from each wheel’s acquisition date). "Real" only counts days with at least one real draw. Computed.
formula.clients: Active clients: approved accounts (resellers excluded) with an attribution during the period or an active campaign; resellers: those holding at least one wheel. Computed.
formula.avgShort: Recognized short-rental revenue ÷ number of recognized short rentals. Computed.
formula.activations: Number and amount of recognized activation entries (one per sub-rental). Real.
formula.apiRatio: API costs imputed ÷ recognized revenue of the period. Computed.
formula.coverage: Wheels whose (cumulative contribution ÷ lot cost) ≥ 100 %, among wheels whose lot cost is known. Computed.
